ratios.label: Revenue growth
ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: 9M 2026 and HY 2026 are not the same kind of period, so a percentage change between them would compare part of a year with a whole one

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file, not on 9M 2026, the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the income statement and the balance sheet share no period (income newest HY 2026, balance newest FY2025), so earnings, book value and the market cap cannot be put on one period. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
